channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: UN agency begins clearing huge Gaza City waste dump
item.description: CAIRO/GAZA: The United Nations Development Programme began clearing a huge wartime garbage dump on Wednesday that has swallowed one of Gaza City’s oldest commercial districts and is an environmental and health risk.

item.title: Boat seized as authorities step up action against illegal Malaysia-Thai border crossings
item.description: RANTAU PANJANG: Kelantan enforcement agencies have begun taking firm action against boats ferrying Malaysians illegally across the Golok River along the Malaysia-Thailand border.

item.title: Maxis Q4 net profit up 18pct, declares special dividend
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Maxis Bhd’s net profit rose 18.4 per cent to RM380 million for the fourth quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 (4Q FY25), from RM321 million a year earlier, driven by stronger operating performance.

item.title: Husband and wife found dead in suspected murder-suicide
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A dispute between a married couple is believed to have ended in a murder-suicide after their bodies were found in a blood-stained room at a house in Sunway SPK Damansara, Kepong, yesterday.

item.title: ICE actions in Minnesota may constitute extrajudicial executions: UN
item.description: MOSCOW: The actions of United States (US) authorities against protesters in Minneapolis, Minnesota, may constitute extrajudicial executions, Sputnik/RIA Novosti reported, citing UN experts.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Zarina Anjoulie urges women to prioritise stability over romance
item.description: CONTROVERSIAL actress Zarina Anjoulie has sparked a heated online debate after dismissing the romanticised notion of couples sticking together “through thick and thin” as a hollow narrative that rarely favours women.

item.title: Russia sends 'hundreds' of missiles, drones at Kyiv, Dnipro and Odesa
Ministry to table amendments to Competition Act to curb cartel practices
item.description: SABAK BERNAM: The Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Ministry expects to table amendments to the Competition Act 2010 and the Competition Commission Act 2010 by the next parliamentary session.

item.title: Bersatu faces risk of split if Hamzah sacked, says Hulu Langat info chief
item.description: PETALING JAYA: Bersatu faces a potential split if deputy president Datuk Seri Hamzah Zainudin is sacked, amid simmering factionalism between camps aligned with him and secretary-general Datuk Seri Azmin Ali.

item.title: Trump says no 'definitive' agreement with Netanyahu, talks with Iran to continue
item.description: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump said after talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday they reached no “definitive” agreement on how to move forward with Iran but he insisted negotiations with Teheran would continue to see if a deal can be achieved.
